alerts.name: regulatory_deadline_breached
alerts.threshold: breached > 0 on live traffic (board commitment 5: zero late filings)
alerts.page: Regulatory Affairs on-call + QA Lead (Kavitha Reddy role)
alerts.runbook_step: Pull storm-safe queue ordered by reg_deadline_utc; file notification from evidence bundle; open INC; do not wait for disposition.

alerts.name: regulatory_deadline_at_risk
alerts.threshold: any reportable case with <25% of window remaining and no notification artefact
alerts.runbook_step: Promote case to front of queue; attach partial evidence; draft notification; page Regulatory if <6h remain.

alerts.name: evidence_chain_verification_failure
alerts.threshold: verify_chain ok == false for any tenant with length > 0
alerts.runbook_step: Freeze sign-off for that tenant; restore evidence dir from WORM snapshot; re-verify; invalidate suspect bundle ids.

alerts.name: decision_mix_drift
alerts.threshold: any disposition share drifts >5pp vs approved baseline (INC-2411 class)
alerts.runbook_step: Halt rule_pack promotion; run shadow replay on golden set; publish diff; require Rao sign-off before re-enable.

alerts.name: data_feed_staleness
alerts.threshold: reference feed age >24h in production (prototype: workbook mtime)
alerts.runbook_step: Check ThermaTrace/ERP/Docuvault connectors; if pack-only lab mode, re-run ingest --reload after feed repair.

alerts.name: queue_age
alerts.threshold: open actionable age >12h OR any reportable age >50% of its window (INC-2502)
alerts.runbook_step: Enable storm brake; route unverified historical facility/duplicate candidates to human review; drain by reg_deadline_utc ASC.

alerts.name: firmware_bulletin_change
alerts.threshold: vendor bulletin hash/version changes vs last approved ref_snapshot
alerts.page: Platform on-call + Marieke de Vries notified on version change (Aurastat ask)
alerts.runbook_step: Run shadow-bulletin; open Dr Rao gate; re-adjudicate affected firmware cohort; withdraw carrier invoices if liability flips (INC-2506).

note: Pack is stratified historical data; breached/at-risk counts here demonstrate the monitor against known INC/late rows, not live pages.
